source.custom: Backgrounds: feat only, no ASI (2026-11-06 ruling).

system.description:
Hermit

You lived in seclusion-either in a community or alone-for a formative part of your life. In your time apart from society, you found quiet, solitude, and perhaps some of the answers you or your family were looking for.

Skill Proficiencies: Animal Handling, History

Tool Proficiencies: Choose one between Poison Kit, Medicine Kit, Trappers Kit

Equipment: A diary of your experiences, a winter blanket, a set of common clothes, a poison kit.

Equipment Pack: Explorer’s or Crafter’s Pack (Choose one).

Feature: Discovery

Your time in seclusion produced a unique discovery: a forgotten truth, a piece of lost knowledge, or a remarkable find. Work with your GM to define this discovery before play begins. You have advantage on all checks directly related to the subject of your discovery and are treated as proficient in any skill check that involves it, even if you would not normally be.

Secluded

Gain a General or Skill feat from Chapter 13 (Recommended: Any Intelligence based Skill Feat)
